title: Cloudron deploy without Actions artifacts
summary: Unblocked production deploys by packaging the tested revision on the Cloudron deploy runner instead of uploading the release tarball to GitHub Actions artifact storage.
changes: Rebuilt and packaged the tested commit in the Cloudron deploy job so deploys no longer depend on GitHub Actions artifact storage quota.
Isolated pull-request CI from the Cloudron concurrency lock so pull-request runs cannot queue production deploys.
affected_areas: GitHub Actions Cloudron deploy workflow and release packaging script
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch release restoring Cloudron delivery after GitHub Actions artifact storage quota blocked otherwise successful test and packaging jobs.
validation: Deployment authentication contract tests cover packaging without Actions artifacts, and source-controlled release-history validation covers this patch record.
known_limitations: This patch does not change application features, authorization, or data. GitHub Actions artifact storage quota may still apply to other workflows that upload artifacts.
rollback: Revert this patch record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, deploy workflow, and package-release script. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the Cloudron deploy artifact-quota work for MyAPES Account issue #49 and pull request #50.
